diffs.diff: acceleration_mg: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001, 0.001
diffs.evidence: LIS3DH datasheet (Doc ID 17530) Table 3 Mechanical characteristics: 'So Sensitivity, FS bit set to 00: 1 mg/digit' (2/4/12 mg/digit at FS 01/10/11). The second reading expresses this in mg per count (1); the model's sim measures use unit 'g' (sim.unit = "g", controls in g) with scale 0.001 g per count after the >>4 shift of the left-justified 12-bit high-resolution value, i.e. 0.001 g = 1 mg per digit at +-2 g. Same value, different but equivalent units; the driver likewise uses 1 mg/digit / 1000 to return g.
